notes.title: Patch 1.0.5
notes.content: [p]1.0.5 - Extended Soundtrack And More Patch [/p][p][/p][p]While reviews of the game are extremely positive, the most common negative comment is lack of music throughout large parts of the game. This has been remedied with this patch. [/p][p][/p][p]- Updated the Island theme - heard throughout the island.[/p][p]- Added Sumerian theme - heard in Sumerian temples and shrines.[/p][p]- Added Hexus theme - heard in Hexus facilities.[/p][p]- Added Sanctuary theme - heard in the witches' sanctuary.[/p][p]- Added Town theme - heard in Port-Town.[/p][p]- Added Resistance theme - heard in the resistance headquarters.[/p][p]- Sound and music volume, tips and combat speed are now set and saved globally - they won't change when you start a new game or load a game. Since they're not loaded from your saves anymore, you will have to reset them the first time you run the game.[/p][p]- There's an auto order button now - basic attacks are set and executed automatically, to speed up simpler battles. It's either bumper on the controller, or F on the keyboard.[/p][p]- Despondent spirit (Hunter in the arena) has an interaction now in New Game+, if you found the relaxation chamber.[/p][p]- After you finish New Game+ there is now an end credits/thank-you note, followed by a short post credits scene.[/p][p]- The player character comments on the wasteland you can't enter outside of the clone laboratory now.[/p][p]- There are spirit vines in Delta vault now, so you can gain experipence before fighting Renée Bellox.[/p][p]- Added missing combat backgrounds for Hexus, forest and school atrium.[/p][p]- Fixed a bug where you wouldn't get the resistance quest line if you had Sid summoned when talking to Yonah for the first time.[/p][p]- Fixed a number of glitches, typos and bugs.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
1.0.4 - Refinement Patch

We're finally at a point where most of the content I originally imagined (excluding the Tiny Kreechers card game, look forward to 1.1) is in the game. The following are the most visible changes.

- Updated some of the texts.
- Updated some of the combat animations and effects.
- Mephistopheles has a slightly different sprite now.
- The CEO is now robed and masked, up until your meeting. There are sporadic images and mentions of him before that.
- There is a cargo boat that ships golems from the factory now. It becomes permanently docked after the Administrator stops production, creating a path between the town and the factory's back entrance.
- Fixed a few issues with rewinding and skipping certain cutscenes.
- Fixed a bug with delivering blueprints to Chomsky, where your Keychain would be blanked in your inventory. Loading saves with that issue should fix it, giving you access to your keys back.

I have a few smaller patches similar to this one planned. Adding a few more music tracks is at the top of the list.

Thank you all for your continued support!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
1.0.3 - Achievements Patch

The game now has Steam Achievements.

Most of the achievements are retroactive, you just have to load a save game where you achieved them to get them. There are a few exceptions:

- Finishing the game
- Finishing NG+ (obviously this isn't in the save, so you'll have to enter the Void again to get these)
- Entering the secret lab (you will probably get this, if you opened the chest or took the report, otherwise you'll have to reenter to get it)
- Entering the secret room at the temple (there is nothing that tracks if you've been there, so you'll have to reenter this one)

If you get a whole bunch at a time, you might have to restart Steam for it to update them all.

Happy achievement hunting!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
1.0.2 - Spycraft and Lore Patch

This is a big one.

- Saves now include a time stamp. This obviously isn't retroactive, only new saves will have that.
- Map shows your location. Only works outside.
- You can now bug anyone with the listening bug.
- Pandemonium and Soul Guide slight redesign. Soul Guide now has a little bit of background information on spirits you bond with.
- A book on the Ancients named The Travelers & The Impostors. It's in a bookcase in the Sanctuary.
- A journal of the interrogation of Crom named The Word Of Crom. It's in a chest in front of his prison, it unlocks after you defeat him.
- A few more hints on certain puzzles.
- Enemies won't attack spirits that were summoned that turn now.
- Empathy trait now shows if the spirit will accept your bond, and if they'll break the folio.
- Emancipation trait is called Unionization now and it makes all your spells cost 0 hp.
- You can use Grow spell on yourself now. It only wears off after you sleep.
- Acheos has a secret interaction now (might be related to previous point).
- There is a new room in the Sanctuary (might be related to previous point).
- Redesign of the henge to be more in line with the architecture of the Ancients.
- Arena fights on level 4 and 5 have a bit more variety now.
- There is a quicktravel connecting level 2 of the arena (at the vault), and level 6 of the arena.
- Chomsky has two new quests. One is the existing 'Get arm blaster' quest. If you completed that quest already you can still bring it in to get the dialogue.
- All witches, including Hakuin, have something to say after you defeat Crom.
- Artemis has something to say when you visit the resistance with her.
- Moshie as Mephistopheles has something to say about the ancients (you need to read The Travelers & The Impostors book to unlock it),
- Bonewinkle, Spirit Union and Yonah have comments on CEO's death.
- Yonah has comments on the Anti-Spirit League (you need to see their booth to unlock it).
- New NPC Baphomet, located at the docks
- New NPC Twist-Tail, located in the secret room in the Sanctuary.
- A whole bunch of small fixes.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
1.0.1 - Frustration Alleviation Patch

A number of players expressed frustration over either puzzles being too hard to figure out, or combat being too hard, or both. So to address a few of these frustrations I did the following:

- There are a few more hints you can get from the world for certain puzzles.
- There are a few more helpful responses to the 'What should we do next" question that you can pose to all of your spirits. 
- There is a 'Difficulty Slider' in the options now. It has four difficulties, so to speak:
1. The hardest is what the game was up until now.
2. Then you have an option that gives you hints on post-it notes in your journal on important quests.
3. The third one makes spirits less aggressive and gives more exp in combat.
4. The easiest option gives you both, the hints and less punishing combat.

I have also fixed a few smaller bugs and glitches. I have also made a workaround for your autosaves that have been bricked at the portal. Azazel Vault now opens even if your spirits have died.

notes.title: Patch 0.9
notes.content:
[b]0.9 - Last Early Access Patch[/b]

This will be the the final patch before release.

There is New Game+ in the game now. You can unlock it in the options, or by finishing the game.
All quests and most dialogues are still from normal game though, so primarily it's to test the combat mechanics.

There are Witches now in the game, but their sanctuary is still unpopulated and very much work in progress.

The Chain Trap ability now only triggers on spirits whose contract you do not have.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.5
notes.content:
[b]0.8.5 - Resistance Patch[/b]

There's a resistance hiding somewhere now, and they have a few optional things for you to do. I've also unlocked the marina office and the guild house, but it's still missing some things.

Arena is finished but it's not totally balanced, probably. There is also an end boss to the arena. It may look impossible, but it can be defeated, if you try enough.

You can now get the arm blaster along with three programs (spells) for it.

You can also contract Sid and Max now.

notes.title: Patch 0.8
notes.content:
[b]0.8 - Story Patch[/b]

You can play the main storyline from start to finish, excluding New Game+. There the story will continue. In 1.0 you'll be able to start NG+ without finishing the game first. All, or near all (I might add one or two in 1.0) spirits are implemented, most are capturable (You can't capture Sid, Max or Muninn anywhere right now).

- Final act (Finishing the main story)

- All spirits implemented

- Tether and Capture are now one spell - Capture, cost is 0 HP

- You can now Summon and Dismiss in combat. Summon is a spell and takes a turn, Dismiss is instantaneous

- Spirits can Absorb and Expel in combat, both is instantaneous

- Dismissing spirits outside of combat doesn't exhaust them anymore, so you can freely switch them out without resting

- Dismissing spirits in combat exhausts them only if their HP isn't full

- Significantly boosted EXP in early fights

- Lowered chance of encounters in some areas, notably the path to the Temple of Uruk (previously known as Sumerian Temple)

- Cutscenes work differently, you confirm to advance them, and you can go back to previous slides

notes.title: Patch 0.4.3
notes.content:
[b]0.4.3 - More Options Patch[/b]

You can set combat speed, music and sound level in the options now. I added a few more fishes and a fishing spot near the temple. You can buy bait at the docks in town. I added and changed a bit of the outside world.

- Combat speed option

- Music level option

- Sounds level option

- More fish types

- Sumerian temple fishing spot

- Bait shop

- Expanded world

notes.title: Patch 0.4.2
notes.content:
[b]0.4.2 - Small Fixes Patch[/b]

I made Azazel of Uruk larger, more in line with his design as I envisioned it. Now there is a disclaimer at the start of the game when you first run it. Lastly, I fixed a couple of minor bugs and graphical glitches.

- Azazel sprite changed and finished

- Minor bug fixes

- Various graphical fixes

notes.title: Patch 0.4.1
notes.content:
[b]0.4.1 - Better Journal and More[/b]

- Journal is now a bit more readable, presented as a checklist with small hints here and there.

- Battle Tips are now Playing Tips, to guide new players (they pop up to prompt training and summoning)

- Rebalanced item prices (third eye is 500, spirit ward is 1000)

- You get Exp if you find third eye in the wild

- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: PATCH 0.4.0
notes.content:
[b]0.4.0 - Content and Fishing Update[/b]

I added quite a lot of content that still needs proper implementing, polish and testing that I'll be unlocking in future 0.4.x patches. This patch is the setup for that.

- Fishing is in the game. Currently 6 out of 32 fishes are implemented. More are coming in 0.4.x patches.

- There are 2 new greater spirits available: Bonewinkle and Azazel of Uruk. More are coming in 0.4.x patches.

- One more level of the arena is accessible.

- Inn area unlocked, but not populated.


Old saves are obsolete, but future 0.4.x patches will work with 0.4.0 saves.


Thank you all for your patience and feedback.
Hope to see you on the discord server: discord.gg/Ghe2gdW or on the Steam Forums.

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1
notes.content:
0.3.1 - UI Improvements Patch

I've made it so information about spirits and spells is more readily available.

Now you can see the power and toughness, and all magics and traits of a spirit right inside the character screen.

In combat each spell now shows how much damage / heal it will do, and to who.

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS IS COMING
notes.content:
[b]WEIRDLANDS IS COMING TO EARLY ACCESS[/b]

I naively thought the game would be complete by now, but it's not, so I decided not to push the release date, but rather make it early access.
Since all the feedback I received from people playing the demo made Weirdlands so much better, I think this will be the best for the game.
The demo is not representative of the game in its current state, and will be less and less so as I improve it, so I'm removing the demo from Steam for now. Maybe I'll reinstate it when the game is finished and I update it to represent the game in its finished state.

The date for [b]Early Access is December 23rd[/b].


Some of the changes from the demo to the current version:

COMBAT:
- In random encounters there's a 50-50 chance of you or the enemy having the first move
- Guard ability is a switch, it happens instantly without you having to execute the turn
- Your moves happen immediately after you execute the turn
- Summoner (main character) can guard
- Numerous spirits, abilities and traits

WORLD:
- Teleport chalk ability is two way now, you can always return to the spot you last used it at
- Quick travel plates let you travel between certain places in the world
- You can buy a spirit ward that prevents random encounters (it costs you experi-pence each step)
- You can get a tent that lets you sleep on any terrain that doesn't spawn random encounters
- Numerous new areas, npcs and puzzles

Now let's make Weirdlands even better!


PS.: Since it's clearly impossible for me to estimate release dates, there won't be one. Instead there will be an [u][b]official to-do list[/b][/u] that I'll update regularly, so you'll be able to track the progress and see what's left to be done. The list will be stickied in the discussion boards and on my Discord server (discord.gg/Ghe2gdW).

notes.title: Patch 0.1.2
notes.content:
New in v0.1.2:

-Wisp spirit added

-Bat spirit added

-Third Eye item added


I added the weakest spirit, Wisp (2 hp, 1 attack damage). It only spawns on the patch of green grass in the corridor. It exists so you don't get murdered in the first fight you are likely to trigger. I also moved the Empathy trait from Cherry Apple to it, so there is a reason to capture/befriend it, while enabling easier capturing/befriending of future spirits.

Bat spirit is a level above Fiend spirits with 8 hp and 4 attack damage.

You can now buy Third Eye from the vending machine. It gives you the ability to see the hp of spirits, making it easier to capture/befriend them.
